question.problem:
The sum of the outcomes of one roll of two unfair four-sided dice follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the sum of the outcomes for one roll of the two dice?

| $f(x)$ | $\frac{3}{40}$ | $\frac{7}{40}$ | $\frac{1}{5}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{3}{20}$ | $\frac{1}{10}$ | $\frac{1}{20}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |

$\text{E}[X]=$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5) \\  & \,\,+6\cdot f(6)+7\cdot f(7)+8\cdot f(8) \\  & =2(\frac{3}{40})+3(\frac{7}{40})+4(\frac{1}{5})+5(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & \,\,+6(\frac{3}{20})+7(\frac{1}{10})+8(\frac{1}{20}) \\  & =\frac{6}{40}+\frac{21}{40}+\frac{4}{5}+\frac{5}{4}+\frac{18}{20}+\frac{7}{10}+\frac{8}{20} \\  & =\frac{6}{40}+\frac{21}{40}+\frac{32}{40}+\frac{50}{40}+\frac{36}{40}+\frac{28}{40}+\frac{16}{40} \\  & =\frac{6+21+32+50+36+28+16}{40} \\  & =\frac{189}{40} \\  & =4.725.\end{aligned}
$$
